turns.question: Today is 1 October 2026. How much revenue did we make over the last 7 days?
turns.answer: Revenue was 3,360.75 EUR over the last 7 full days, 24 to 30 September 2026 (today, 1 October, not included). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
